title: Events
intro: Fantasy Land is one world running on your own PC, so there are no realms, home servers or server hopping to worry about. Events come in three kinds: holidays you switch on yourself, scheduled events that follow the game's clock, and rare creatures that turn up on their own.
holidays_text: Holiday Season, Lunar New Year, Valentine's, Halloween and Egg Hunt. Switch any of them on or off while you play with the candy cane button above the skill bar.
monsters_text: Grinch, Snowman, Mr Pumpkin, Mr Green, Slenderman, Dragold, Love Goo and Wabbit each have their own switch in the same menu. They spawn even when their holiday is off.
scheduled_text: Every day at 13:00 and 20:00 UTC, Goo Brawl, Giga Crab or A/B Testing starts, taking turns. At 23:00 UTC it's Ice Golem or Franky. The game has to be running at the time.
rare_text: Golden bats, cute bees, mimics and other rare monsters appear on their own as you play.
button_text: While a scheduled event is running, an EVENT button can appear in game. Click it to join.
travel_text: Event bosses and holiday monsters live on the map. Walk there, or use {smart_move} in CODE.
npcs_text: Some holidays add an NPC with a shop or an exchange.
settings_text: Drop luck, gold and the other Mod Menu settings apply to event drops too.
note: Bean's home server and Favoré's server blessings come from the online game. With only one world they don't change anything, so you can ignore them.
